text: This report recommends that the name "Myer Willinsky Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane north of Queen Street East, extending between Parliament Street and Trefan Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Myer Willinsky Lane" for an existing public lane north of Queen Street East, extending between Parliament Street and Trefan Street.
